d_and_a.source: not found: D&A not mapped in the ESEF data (null in tool result); not filled from memory

capex.source: ifrs-full:PurchaseOfPropertyPlantAndEquipmentClassifiedAsInvestingActivities, same ESEF reports (PP&E purchases only; excludes capitalised intangibles)

revenue_growth.source: Assumption: history shows +6.3% FY24 and +5.2% FY25; growth fades from ~6% toward 4.5% as the base grows. Not a company guidance figure.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: held near FY2025 reported margin 6,699/40,152 = 16.7% (FY24 16.9%, FY23 16.5%); no expansion assumed.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: approximately the French statutory rate (25.8%) less some mix benefit. Effective rate not derived from filings here.

da_pct_revenue.source: Assumption, placeholder: D&A not found in the tool data, so there is no historical basis. Reviewer must verify against the annual report cash flow statement.

capex_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: FY2025 capex 1,072/40,152 = 2.7% (FY24 2.5%, FY23 2.5%). Excludes capitalised intangibles, which were not available.

wacc.source: Assumption: CAPM cost of equity = ECB 10Y AAA yield 3.266% (2026-11-05) + beta ~1.1 x ERP ~5% = ~8.8%. Cost of debt ~4% pre-tax, and debt weight ~15%, gives WACC of ~8%. Beta and ERP are judgment values and were not pulled from valuation_inputs.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: long-run euro area nominal growth/inflation, below the 3.27% risk-free rate.

net_debt.source: deskstack derived net_debt = borrowings_noncurrent 15,021 - cash 4,634 (ESEF 969500A1YF1XUYYXS284-2025-12-31-ESEF-FR-0). Current borrowings and short-term investments were not tagged, so net debt may be understated.

diluted_shares.source: Derived, not reported: net income attributable to owners 4,163M / diluted EPS 7.33 (ESEF 2025-12-31), in millions of shares. The weighted diluted share count was null in the tool.
